policy: Do not award a numeric score to an unverified dimension. Route-level browser success does not score every component on that route. No whole-application numeric score is calculated because the available evidence does not support it.

coverage.confidence: LOW for application-wide quality; moderate for source inventory completeness
coverage.tested_component_states: Selective journey-level browser testing only; no exhaustive component-state coverage

note: Per-component records are intentionally not fabricated. All 221 inventory records carry NOT_TESTED visual, functional, and accessibility statuses. Add score records only after independent evidence is collected for each dimension; use NOT_TESTED for all other dimensions.
